item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:00 HKT 28/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China tomorrow. Under the influence of the relatively dry northeast monsoon, it will be brighter in the following couple of days. An anticyclone aloft will affect Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will improve and it will be hot during the day over the region. Another trough of low pressure will bring a few showers to the coastal areas in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 29/04 (Saturday)
Wind: East to southeast force 2 to 3, north force 4 later.
Weather: Sunny intervals and relatively low visibility in some areas at first. A few showers and isolated thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 22 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
